title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Sports analyst Rob Parker doubts the Boston Red Sox will make the playoffs despite recent strong performance.
The Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot after a 32-5 run, with a 64-52 record.
FanGraphs estimates Boston's playoff chances at 96%, with odds of clinching a wild-card spot at 83.4%.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from Saturday's game due to leg swelling after being hit on Friday.
Red Sox coach Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup for Sunday's game against the Athletics.
Abreu ranks second on the team with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, and holds a .256 batting average in 2026.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to Athletics on Saturday.
Jake Bennett, Red Sox starter, allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, with Athletics leading by the fifth inning.
Red Sox holds second AL wild-card spot, trailing Yankees by 1.5 games; they aim for 10th series win on Sunday.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is installing a new turf surface before the Patriots' preseason opener after the recent World Cup.
The NFL requires a different turf certification that wasn't met, prompting this second surface installation of the summer.
The stadium's turf didn't comply with NFL protocols due to missing a testing window and not using an 'E-layer.'

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, with goals from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Jack Harrison made his debut for the Revolution but couldn't prevent the team's defeat after joining in late July.
Houston's defensive strategy and counterattacks effectively neutralized New England's offense throughout the match.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony, out since May with a wrist injury, begins hitting off pitching machines at higher velocities.
Adley Rutschman made his first rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings.
Boston Red Sox continue 9-game winning streak, poised to strengthen with returns of Anthony and Rutschman.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix adds 'Clueless' (1995), 'Eighth Grade' (2018), and 'Something's Gotta Give' (2003) this August.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' premieres on Paramount+, exploring new adventures 20 years after the original series.
Season 4 of 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' is praised for strong time-travel and alien-themed episodes on Paramount+.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an eight-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England according to the BFRO.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett argues there's no scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence, despite numerous regional reports.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, and advice columnist passed away at 86 in July 2026.
Margo Howard wrote 'Dear Prudence' for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for The Boston Globe.
Meredith Goldstein shares how Margo Howard influenced her perspective on grief and personal happiness.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Boston Red Sox defeated the Oakland Athletics 13-1, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Pitcher Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in six innings, allowing two hits and no walks.
The Red Sox offense produced 15 hits, with Jarren Duran hitting a two-run homer and Wilyer Abreu contributing three RBIs.
